descriptionByLocale.fr:
L’EMS Les Clos d’Aubonne a ouvert ses portes en octobre 2024 et compte 56 lits, couvrant deux missions : la gériatrie et la psychiatrie de l'âge avancé. L'institution bénéficie également de 12 places d'accueil temporaire, y compris le CAT mémoire. Surplombant les vignes et le lac, l’EMS d’Aubonne vous accueille dans un cadre chaleureux et dynamique. Situé à proximité du bourg, il donne facilement accès aux commerces et cafés à proximité. Quelque 70 collaboratrices et collaborateurs y travaillent.

Afin de renforcer son service d'Intendance, nous recherchons pour l'EMS Les Clôs d'Aubonne un(e) :

Agent de propreté (F/H) à 80%-90%

CDI, entrée en fonction dès le 01/11/2026 ou à convenir

NOUS VOUS OFFRONS

• 5 semaines de vacances annuelles, 6 semaines dès l'âge de 50 ans. Possibilité de rachat d'une semaine de vacances supplémentaire, ainsi que 10 jours fériés offerts.

• Plusieurs propositions apportant de la flexibilité (congés non-payés, temps partiels, temps de change rémunéré, etc.).

• Une rémunération basée sur la valorisation de vos années d'expériences professionnelles précédentes, ainsi que des primes liées à l'ancienneté au sein de l'EHC.

• Un plan mobilité comprenant une participation à votre trajet à vélo, en basket ou à votre abonnement aux transports publics, dans un souci de l'environnement suivant un plan durabilité au niveau institutionnel.

• Des cours de pilates gratuits, une participation financière à des événements sportifs tels que les 20km de Lausanne ou Bike to Work, un catalogue d’avantages proposant des rabais dans les domaines du sport, du bien-être, des loisirs, de la mobilité, des assurances et des finances.

• Les boissons chaudes offertes le matin et des repas à CHF 8.50 dans nos cafétérias.

• Une buvette d'entreprise « Pâquis Plage » pour partager des moments de convivialité lors des beaux jours.

• Des possibilités de mutations à l'interne, selon vos envies de développement.

• De nombreuses formations internes ou certifiantes accessibles.

• Un programme dédié aux cadres pour les accompagner dans l'acquisition des compétences nécessaires à la gestion de leurs équipes.

VOUS POSSÉDEZ

• Un CFC d’Agent-e de propreté ou formation jugée équivalente

• Des connaissances de base des produits, normes d'hygiène et techniques de nettoyage.

• Un niveau de français C1 ou plus, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.

• Une capacité à travailler en équipe et de la méthodologie.

• De la polyvalence et une faculté d'adaptation.

• Une posture professionnelle et une aisance dans les échanges avec les seniors.

• Une possibilité de travailler entre 07h00 et 16h00.

VOS OBJECTIFS

• Répondre avec bienveillance aux besoins des résidents dans le cadre de vos missions et participer à créer une atmosphère chaleureuse et respectueuse.

• Effectuer les activités de nettoyage des locaux, des équipements et du matériel ainsi que du mobilier.

• Assurer la mise en place et le service du petit déjeuné pour les résidents.

• Assurer, au besoin, la mise en place et le service du repas de midi pour les résidents.

• Collaborer efficacement avec les équipes soignantes, hôtelières et techniques afin d'assurer un accompagnement de qualité.

• Utiliser les diverses machines de nettoyage lors de nettoyages à fonds.

• Planifier et organiser les nettoyages courants et à fonds.

NOUS SOMMES

• Une institution comprenant des établissements de soins aigus et réadaptation, une clinique privée, des EMS, des centres médicaux et des permanences répartis dans la région de La Côte ainsi que la 1ère école d'hypnose clinique dédiée au milieu du soins en Suisse romande.

• Un réseau de soins permettant de nombreuses opportunités de mutation interne selon les aspirations et projets de développement des collaborateurs.

• Plus de 2000 collaborateurs prenant soin des patients et résidents de la région, en partageant des valeurs de Responsabilité, Proximité, Humanité, Compétence, dans un environnement agile favorisant la réalisation des projets.

• Une entreprise formatrice engagée dans la formation de la relève, comptant environ 80 apprentis dans 16 métiers différents, 200 stagiaires HES-ES et près de 300 médecins en formation.

ENSEMBLE CÔTE À CÔTE, SOYEZ LE PROCHAIN TALENT DE NOTRE RESEAU DE SOIN.

Vous reconnaissez-vous dans cette description ?
Cliquez sur Postulez en ajoutant les documents suivants :
 CV, lettre de motivation, certificats de travail (nécessaires pour l'élaboration du calcul de salaire) et diplômes.
 Si votre candidature est sélectionnée, l’extrait de votre casier judiciaire vous sera demandé.
descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Clos d'Aubonne aprì le porte nell'ottobre 2024 e ha 56 posti letto, coprendo due missioni: geriatria e psichiatria avanzata. L'istituzione beneficia anche di 12 posti di ricevimento temporanei, tra cui memoria CAT. Affacciato sui vigneti e sul lago, l'EMS Aubonne vi accoglie in un ambiente caldo e dinamico. Situato vicino al villaggio, offre un facile accesso a negozi e caffè nelle vicinanze. Ci lavorano circa 70 collaboratori.

Per rafforzare il suo servizio di orientamento, stiamo cercando un EMS Les Clôs d'Aubonne:

Agente di pulizia (M/F) a 80%-90%

CDI, a partire dal 01/11/2026 o da concordare

Noi ti

• 5 settimane di vacanza annuale, 6 settimane dall'età di 50 anni. Possibilità di acquistare un'altra settimana di vacanza, così come 10 vacanze offerte.

• Varie proposte che offrono flessibilità ( congedo non retribuito, congedo part-time, tempo di cambio pagato, ecc.).

• Remunerazione basata sulla valutazione dei vostri anni precedenti di esperienza professionale, così come bonus di anzianità all'interno dell'EHC.

• Un piano di mobilità che include la partecipazione al tuo abbonamento in bicicletta, basket o trasporto pubblico, con un focus ambientale su un piano di sostenibilità istituzionale.

• Corsi di pilates gratuiti, partecipazione finanziaria a eventi sportivi come i 20 km di Losanna o Bike to Work, un catalogo di vantaggi che offrono sconti nei settori dello sport, del benessere, del tempo libero, della mobilità, dell'assicurazione e della finanza.

• Bevande calde offerte al mattino e pasti a CHF 8.50 nelle nostre mense.

• Una bevanda aziendale "Pâquis Plage" per condividere momenti di convivialità durante le belle giornate.

• Opportunità per il cambiamento interno, secondo il vostro desiderio di sviluppo.

• Molti corsi di formazione in-house o di certificazione.

• Un programma dedicato ai manager per aiutarli ad acquisire le competenze necessarie per gestire le loro squadre.

Tu lo sai

• Un agente di pulizia CFC o formazione equivalente

• Conoscenza di base di prodotti, norme igieniche e tecniche di pulizia.

• Un livello di francese C1 o più, sia orale che scritta.

• Capacità di lavorare in team e metodologie.

• Polivalenza e adattabilità.

• Postura professionale e facilità nel trattare con gli anziani.

• Un'opportunità di lavorare tra le 07:00 e le 16:00.

OBIETTIVI

• Rispondere gentilmente alle esigenze dei residenti nelle vostre missioni e partecipare alla creazione di un'atmosfera calda e rispettosa.

• Eseguire attività di pulizia per locali, attrezzature e attrezzature e mobili.

• Assicurare l'istituzione e il servizio di colazione per i residenti.

• Assicurare, se necessario, la fornitura e il servizio di pranzo per i residenti.

• Lavorare efficacemente con i team sanitari, alberghi e tecnici per garantire un supporto di qualità.

• Utilizzare varie macchine di pulizia durante la pulizia del fondo.

• Pianificare e organizzare la pulizia di routine e fondi.

Siamo

• Un'istituzione costituita da strutture di cura e riabilitazione acuta, una clinica privata, SME, centri medici e permanenze nella regione di La Côte e la prima scuola di ipnosi clinica dedicata alla comunità di cura in Svizzera francofona.

• Una rete di cura che permette molte opportunità di trasformazione interna secondo le aspirazioni e i progetti di sviluppo dei collaboratori.

• Più di 2.000 dipendenti che si occupano di pazienti e residenti della regione, condividono valori di Responsabilità, Proximità, Umanità, Competenza, in un ambiente agile favorevole alla realizzazione di progetti.

• Una società di formazione impegnata in formazione di successione, con circa 80 apprendisti in 16 diversi scambi, 200 HES-ES tirocinanti e quasi 300 medici in formazione.

Essere il prossimo evento della nostra rete.

Ti riconosci in questa descrizione?
Fare clic su Applica aggiungendo i seguenti documenti:
 CV, lettera di copertura, certificati di lavoro (necessario per il calcolo dei salari) e diplomi.
 Se la tua domanda è selezionata, ti verrà chiesto l'estratto dal tuo record penale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Clos d'Aubonne opened its doors in October 2024 and has 56 beds, covering two missions: geriatrics and advanced psychiatry. The institution also benefits from 12 temporary reception places, including CAT memory. Overlooking the vineyards and the lake, the Aubonne EMS welcomes you in a warm and dynamic setting. Located close to the village, it offers easy access to shops and cafes nearby. Some 70 collaborators work there.

In order to strengthen its guidance service, we are looking for an EMS Les Clôs d'Aubonne:

Cleaning agent (M/F) at 80%-90%

CDI, starting on 01/11/2026 or to be agreed

WE OFFER YOU

• 5 weeks of annual vacation, 6 weeks from the age of 50. Possibility to buy another week of vacation, as well as 10 holidays offered.

• Several proposals providing flexibility (unpaid leave, part-time leave, paid exchange time, etc.).

• Remuneration based on the valuation of your previous years of professional experience, as well as seniority bonuses within the EHC.

• A mobility plan including participation in your cycling, basketball or public transport subscription, with an environmental focus on an institutional sustainability plan.

• Free pilates courses, financial participation at sporting events such as the 20km of Lausanne or Bike to Work, a catalogue of advantages offering discounts in the fields of sport, well-being, leisure, mobility, insurance and finance.

• Hot drinks offered in the morning and meals at CHF 8.50 in our cafeterias.

• A "Pâquis Plage" business drink to share moments of conviviality during the beautiful days.

• Opportunities for internal change, according to your desire for development.

• Many accessible in-house or certifying training courses.

• A programme dedicated to managers to support them in acquiring the skills necessary to manage their teams.

YOU MAY

• A cleanliness agent CFC or equivalent training

• Basic knowledge of products, hygiene standards and cleaning techniques.

• A level of French C1 or more, both oral and written.

• Ability to work in teams and methodology.

• Polyvalence and adaptability.

• Professional posture and ease in dealing with seniors.

• An opportunity to work between 07:00 and 16:00.

OBJECTIVES

• Respond kindly to the needs of residents in your missions and participate in creating a warm and respectful atmosphere.

• Perform cleaning activities for premises, equipment and equipment and furniture.

• Ensure the establishment and service of breakfast for residents.

• Ensure, as necessary, the provision and service of lunch for residents.

• Work effectively with healthcare, hotel and technical teams to ensure quality support.

• Use various cleaning machines during bottom cleaning.

• Plan and organize routine and fund cleaning.

WE ARE

• An institution consisting of acute care and rehabilitation facilities, a private clinic, EMS, medical centres and permanences in the region of La Côte and the first clinical hypnosis school dedicated to the care community in French-speaking Switzerland.

• A network of care allowing many opportunities for internal transformation according to the aspirations and development projects of the collaborators.

• More than 2,000 employees taking care of patients and residents of the region, sharing values of Responsibility, Proximity, Humanity, Competence, in an agile environment conducive to the realization of projects.

• A training company engaged in succession training, with about 80 apprentices in 16 different trades, 200 HES-ES trainees and nearly 300 doctors in training.

BE THE NEXT TALENT OF OUR CARE NETWORK.

Mit Blick auf die Weinberge und den See begrüßt Sie die Aubonne EMS in einer warmen und dynamischen Umgebung. In der Nähe des Dorfes gelegen, bietet es einfachen Zugang zu Geschäften und Cafés in der Nähe. Dort arbeiten rund 70 Mitarbeiter.

Reinigungsmittel (M/W) bei 80%-90%

CDI, beginnend am 01/11/2026 oder noch zu vereinbaren

• Morgens warme Getränke und Mahlzeiten für CHF 8.50 in unseren Cafeterien.

• Chancen für innere Veränderungen, entsprechend Ihrem Wunsch nach Entwicklung.

• Viele zugängliche interne oder zertifizierende Schulungen.

• Ein Programm, das Managern gewidmet ist, um sie beim Erwerb der Fähigkeiten zu unterstützen, die für das Management ihrer Teams erforderlich sind.

Dürfen

• Ein Cleanlines Agent CFC oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung

• Grundkenntnisse über Produkte, Hygienestandards und Reinigungstechniken.

• Ein Niveau von Französisch C1 oder mehr, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich.

• Fähigkeit, in Teams und Methodik zu arbeiten.

• Polyvalenz und Anpassungsfähigkeit.

• Professionelle Haltung und Leichtigkeit im Umgang mit Senioren.

ZIELE

• Reagieren Sie freundlich auf die Bedürfnisse der Bewohner in Ihren Missionen und beteiligen Sie sich an der Schaffung einer warmen und respektvollen Atmosphäre.

• Führen Sie Reinigungsaktivitäten für Räumlichkeiten, Ausrüstung und Ausrüstung und Möbel durch.

• Stellen Sie die Einrichtung und den Service des Frühstücks für die Bewohner sicher.

• Stellen Sie bei Bedarf die Bereitstellung und den Service des Mittagessens für die Bewohner sicher.

• Arbeiten Sie effektiv mit Gesundheits-, Hotel- und Technikteams zusammen, um eine qualitativ hochwertige Unterstützung zu gewährleisten.

• Verwenden Sie verschiedene Reinigungsmaschinen während der Bodenreinigung.

• Planen und organisieren Sie Routine und finanzieren Sie die Reinigung.

WIR SIND

• Eine Einrichtung, bestehend aus Akut- und Rehabilitationseinrichtungen, einer Privatklinik, EMS, medizinischen Zentren und Daueraufenthalten in der Region La Côte und der ersten klinischen Hypnoseschule, die der Pflegegemeinschaft in der französischsprachigen Schweiz gewidmet ist.

• Ein Netzwerk der Betreuung, das viele Möglichkeiten für die interne Transformation gemäß den Bestrebungen und Entwicklungsprojekten der Mitarbeiter ermöglicht.

• Mehr als 2.000 Mitarbeiter kümmern sich um Patienten und Bewohner der Region und teilen Werte wie Verantwortung, Nähe, Menschlichkeit, Kompetenz in einem agilen Umfeld, das der Realisierung von Projekten förderlich ist.

• Eine Ausbildungsfirma, die sich mit Nachfolgeausbildung beschäftigt, mit etwa 80 Auszubildenden in 16 verschiedenen Berufen, 200 HES-ES-Auszubildenden und fast 300 Ärzten in der Ausbildung.

Sei das nächste Talent unseres Pflegenetzes.

Erkennst du dich selbst in dieser Beschreibung?
Klicken Sie auf Anwenden, indem Sie die folgenden Dokumente hinzufügen:
 Lebenslauf, Anschreiben, Arbeitsbescheinigungen (für die Berechnung der Löhne erforderlich) und Diplome.
 Wenn Ihre Bewerbung ausgewählt ist, werden Sie nach dem Auszug aus Ihrem Strafregister gefragt.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'Hôpital d'Aubonne est au service de sa communauté depuis 1895. Idéalement situé à proximité des vignes et du bourg, il est l'un des trois hôpitaux fondateurs de l'EHC. Il regroupe toutes les missions de l'EHC en un seul lieu : que ce soit pour la médecine de premier recours avec son centre médical, les soins aigus avec ses lits de médecine interne reconnus et son unité de soins palliatifs, le centre de traitement et de réadaptation multisite ou encore les prestations de long séjour avec son EMS et son Centre d'accueil temporaire (CAT).

Nous recherchons pour l'Hôpital d'Aubonne un(e) :

Aide ou ASSC CTR à 50%

Afin de renforcer notre service, CDI de suite ou à convenir

NOUS VOUS OFFRONS

• 5 semaines de vacances annuelles, 6 semaines dès l'âge de 50 ans. Possibilité de rachat d'une semaine de vacances supplémentaire, ainsi que 10 jours fériés offerts.

• Plusieurs propositions apportant de la flexibilité (congés non-payés, temps partiels, temps de change rémunéré, etc.).

• Un plan mobilité comprenant une participation à votre trajet à vélo, en basket ou à votre abonnement aux transports publics, dans un souci de l'environnement suivant un plan durabilité au niveau institutionnel.

• Une rémunération basée sur la valorisation de vos années d'expériences professionnelles précédentes, ainsi que des primes liées à l'ancienneté au sein de l'EHC.

• Des cours de pilates gratuits, une participation financière à des événements sportifs tels que les 20km de Lausanne ou Bike to Work, un catalogue d’avantages proposant des rabais dans les domaines du sport, du bien-être, des loisirs, de la mobilité, des assurances et des finances.

• Les boissons chaudes offertes le matin et des repas à CHF 8.50 dans nos cafétérias.

• Une buvette d'entreprise « Pâquis Plage » pour partager des moments de convivialité lors des beaux jours.

• Des possibilités de mutations à l'interne, selon vos envies de développement.

• De nombreuses formations internes ou certifiantes accessibles.

• Un programme dédié aux cadres pour les accompagner dans l'acquisition des compétences nécessaires à la gestion de leurs équipes.

VOUS POSSÉDEZ

• Un CFC d'assistant·e en soins et santé communautaire (ASSC) ou d'un diplôme d'aide-soignant reconnu CRS

• Une première expérience dans le domaine de la gériatrie, un atout

• L'attestation Gineste-Marescotti (GM), un atout

• Des connaissances du système de santé suisse, un atout

• Une volonté de contribuer à l'amélioration ou au maintien de l'autonomie des patients

• Un excellent relationnel, notamment avec les personnes âgées

• Le sens de l'écoute, de la discrétion et de l'empathie

• De la motivation et une bonne capacité d'adaptation et d'intégration

• Une disponibilité et une flexibilité

VOS OBJECTIFS

• Collaborer avec l'équipe infirmière dans l'assistance aux soins pour la prise en charge des patients

• Accompagner les patients et les aider lors d'une mobilisation

• Aider à la distribution des repas

• Participer à l'adaptation et l'entretien de l'environnement du patient

• Contribuer à l’utilisation efficiente du matériel et de son approvisionnement

NOUS SOMMES

• Une institution comprenant des établissements de soins aigus et réadaptation, une clinique privée, des EMS, des centres médicaux et des permanences répartis dans la région de La Côte ainsi que la 1ère école d'hypnose clinique dédiée au milieu du soins en Suisse romande.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Policlinico, emergenze, assistenza ambulatoriale, ospedalizzazioni: dalla nascita alla terza età, l’Ospedale di Morges offre un’ampia gamma di servizi sanitari. La struttura dispone di 240 letti di cure acute, una maternità con circa 1.500 nascite all’anno e quasi 30.000 consulti di emergenza. In totale, sono più di 40 le discipline mediche praticate nelle sue strutture da oltre 150 anni. Circondato da vigne, con una vista incredibile sulle montagne e sul lago, l’Ospedale di Morges vi accoglie in un ambiente caloroso e dinamico. Cerchiamo per l’ospedale di Morges un/una: Assistente assistenza e salute comunitaria - ASSC medicina (F/H) a 80-100% Inizio immediato o da concordare. Il servizio di medicina del primo piano dispone di 40 letti, di cui 6 dedicati alle cure palliative, e garantisce una presa in carico interdisciplinare di pazienti affetti da cure palliative generali e acute. Il servizio di medicina del secondo piano comprende 43 letti, di cui metà dedicati alle cure acute agli anziani, con una presa in carico interdisciplinare in un ambiente adatto a favorire e mantenere l’autonomia nelle attività quotidiane. OFFRIAMO
• 5 settimane di ferie annuali, 6 settimane a partire dai 50 anni. Possibilità di acquistare una settimana di ferie aggiuntiva, oltre a 10 giorni festivi offerti.
• Diverse proposte per una maggiore flessibilità (congedi non retribuiti, part-time, orari retribuiti, ecc.).
• Un piano di mobilità che include un contributo per il tragitto in bicicletta, a piedi o con l’abbonamento ai trasporti pubblici, nell’ottica di rispetto ambientale e sostenibilità a livello istituzionale.
• Una retribuzione basata sulla valorizzazione degli anni di esperienza professionale precedenti, oltre a premi legati all’anzianità all’interno dell’EHC.
• Corsi di pilates gratuiti, contributi finanziari a eventi sportivi come i 20 km di Losanna o Bike to Work, un catalogo di vantaggi con sconti in ambito sport, benessere, tempo libero, mobilità, assicurazioni e finanza.
• Bevande calde offerte al mattino e pasti a CHF 8.50 nelle nostre caffetterie.
• Una caffetteria aziendale “Pâquis Plage” per condividere momenti di convivialità durante le belle giornate.
• Possibilità di trasferimenti interni, in base alle vostre aspirazioni di sviluppo.
• Numerosi corsi di formazione interni o certificanti accessibili.
• Un programma dedicato ai quadri per accompagnarli nell’acquisizione delle competenze necessarie alla gestione dei loro team. POSSEDI
• Un diploma di Assistente in assistenza e salute comunitaria (ASSC).
• Buone capacità organizzative (anticipare, pianificare, coordinare).
• Buone capacità di ascolto e ottime capacità relazionali.
• Buona gestione emotiva, proattività e flessibilità. OBIETTIVI
• Garantire la presa in carico dei pazienti affidati, considerando i loro bisogni, gli obiettivi di cura e le prescrizioni mediche, nel proprio campo di competenza e sotto delega infermieristica.
• Supportare il benessere fisico, sociale e psicologico dei pazienti e aiutarli a organizzare le attività quotidiane.
• Essere responsabile della gestione dell’ambiente diretto del paziente in termini di igiene e sicurezza.
• Ottimizzare le cure attraverso un approccio personalizzato, globale, multidisciplinare e interprofessionale. SIAMO
• Un’istituzione composta da strutture di cure acute e di riabilitazione, una clinica privata, servizi di assistenza a lungo termine, centri medici e ambulatori distribuiti nella regione di La Côte, oltre alla prima scuola di ipnosi clinica dedicata al settore sanitario in Svizzera romanda.
• Una rete di assistenza che offre numerose opportunità di trasferimenti interni in base alle aspirazioni e ai progetti di sviluppo dei collaboratori.
• Oltre 2000 collaboratori che si prendono cura di pazienti e residenti della regione, condividendo valori di Responsabilità, Prossimità, Umanità, Competenza, in un ambiente agile che favorisce la realizzazione dei progetti.
• Un’azienda formativa impegnata nella formazione della nuova generazione, con circa 80 apprendisti in 16 diversi mestieri, 200 stagisti HES-ES e quasi 300 medici in formazione. INSIEME CÔTE À CÔTE, SII IL PROSSIMO TALENTO DEL NOSTRO NETWORK DI ASSISTENZA. Ti riconosci in questa descrizione? Clicca su Candidati allegando i seguenti documenti: CV, lettera di motivazione, certificati di lavoro (necessari per il calcolo dello stipendio) e diplomi. Se la tua candidatura sarà selezionata, ti verrà richiesto un estratto del casellario giudiziale.

Polyclinic, emergencies, outpatient care, hospitalizations: from birth to old age, the Morges Hospital offers a wide range of healthcare services. The facility has 240 acute care beds, a maternity ward with approximately 1,500 births per year, and nearly 30,000 emergency consultations. In total, over 40 medical disciplines have been practiced within its walls for more than 150 years. Surrounded by vineyards, with an incredible view of the mountains and the lake, Morges Hospital welcomes you in a warm and dynamic environment. We are looking for a: Community Care and Health Assistant - ASSC Medicine (M/F) at 80-100% Start date as soon as possible or to be agreed. The medicine department on the first floor has 40 beds, including 6 dedicated to palliative care, and provides interdisciplinary care for patients with general and acute palliative needs. The medicine department on the second floor includes 43 beds, half of which are dedicated to acute care for seniors, with an interdisciplinary approach in an environment designed to promote and maintain autonomy in daily activities. WE OFFER
• 5 weeks of annual vacation, 6 weeks from age 50. Possibility to purchase an additional week of vacation, plus 10 public holidays.
• Several options offering flexibility (unpaid leave, part-time work, paid change hours, etc.).
• A mobility plan including support for your bike, walking, or public transport subscriptions, aligned with environmental sustainability and institutional durability.
• Compensation based on your previous professional experience, along with seniority bonuses within EHC.
• Free Pilates classes, financial participation in sports events such as the Lausanne 20 km or Bike to Work, and a benefits catalog with discounts in sports, wellness, leisure, mobility, insurance, and finance.
• Hot beverages offered in the morning and meals at CHF 8.50 in our cafeterias.
• An in-company “Pâquis Plage” refreshment stand to share convivial moments during good weather.
• Internal transfer opportunities based on your development aspirations.
• Many internal or certification courses accessible.
• A dedicated program for managers to help them acquire the skills necessary for team management. YOU POSSESS
• A CFC in Community Care and Health Assistance (ASSC).
• Good organizational skills (anticipate, plan, coordinate).
• Excellent listening skills and strong interpersonal abilities.
• Good emotional management, proactivity, and flexibility. YOUR OBJECTIVES
• Ensure the care of the patients entrusted to you, considering their needs, care objectives, and medical orders, within your scope of competence and under nursing delegation.
• Support the physical, social, and psychological well-being of the patients and help organize their daily activities.
• Be responsible for managing the patient’s immediate environment regarding hygiene and safety.
• Optimize care through a personalized, holistic, multidisciplinary, and interprofessional approach. WE ARE
• An institution comprising acute and rehabilitation care facilities, a private clinic, long-term care homes, medical centers, and outpatient clinics across the La Côte region, as well as the first clinical hypnosis school dedicated to the healthcare sector in French-speaking Switzerland.
• A care network offering numerous internal transfer opportunities aligned with employees’ aspirations and development projects.
• Over 2000 staff caring for patients and residents in the region, sharing values of Responsibility, Proximity, Humanity, Competence, in an agile environment that fosters project realization.
• A training-oriented company committed to developing the next generation, with about 80 apprentices in 16 different trades, 200 HES-ES interns, and nearly 300 medical trainees. Click on Apply and attach the following documents: CV, cover letter, work certificates (necessary for salary calculation), and diplomas. If your application is shortlisted, a criminal record extract will be requested.

Assistente medico (M/F) all'80%

Die Einrichtung verfügt über 240 Akutbetten, eine Entbindungsstation mit etwa 1500 Geburten pro Jahr und rund 30000 Notfallbehandlungen. Insgesamt werden in ihren Mauern seit über 150 Jahren mehr als 40 medizinische Fachbereiche praktiziert. Umgeben von Weinbergen, mit einer atemberaubenden Aussicht auf die Berge und den See, begrüßt Sie das Morges-Krankenhaus in einer warmen und dynamischen Umgebung. Wir suchen: Leitende Kliniker (-adjunkte) für Innere Medizin (F/M) in 100%iger Stelle, um das medizinische Team des Medizin-, Stations- oder zu bestimmenden Bereichs zu vervollständigen, für einen Zeitraum von 6 Monaten bis 2 Jahren, der zu definieren ist. Arbeitszeiten zu definieren. Wir bieten:
• Ein Team von hochqualifizierten Trainern, Professoren und Ärzten, das eine hochwertige berufliche Begleitung und Entwicklung sicherstellt.
• Den Ruf des Krankenhauses und seiner Ärzte, der ein erfüllendes und anerkanntes Arbeitsumfeld bietet.
• 5 Tage pro Jahr 'Bildungsurlaub' und CHF 1000 Bildungsausgaben, die innerhalb von 12 Monaten Tätigkeit erstattet werden.
• Mehr als 20 als 'Bildungszentren' anerkannte Fachbereiche
• 5 Wochen Jahresurlaub, 6 Wochen ab dem Alter von 50 Jahren. Möglichkeit, eine zusätzliche Urlaubswoche zu kaufen, und 10 Feiertage angeboten.
• Verschiedene Angebote, die Flexibilität bieten (unbezahlte Urlaubstage, Teilzeit, bezahlte Freizeit, etc.).
• Ein Mobilitätsplan, der die Teilnahme an Ihrer Fahrrad- oder Bustour oder Ihrem öffentlichen Verkehrsmittelsubskription umfasst, im Einklang mit dem Nachhaltigkeitsplan der Institution.
• Sportaktivitäten (Pilates, Laufen, Rabatte in verschiedenen Zentren wie mehreren Fitnessstudios oder den Lavey-Bädern), Veranstaltungen für die Kinder der Mitarbeiter, eine Mitarbeiterkantine, um gemeinsame conviviale Momente an schönen Tagen zu teilen.
• Heiße Getränke morgens und Mahlzeiten zu CHF 8.50 in unseren Kantinen.
• Gehalt basierend auf der Bewertung Ihrer vorherigen beruflichen Erfahrung und Ihrer Seniorität innerhalb des EHC.
• Erleichtertes internes Transferieren entsprechend Ihren Entwicklungsbedürfnissen. Wir erfordern:
• Ein anerkanntes medizinisches Diplom und einen Bundes- oder formell anerkannten Facharzt-Titel in Innerer Medizin oder im Prozess der Erlangung
• Jahre an Erfahrung in der akuten Inneren Medizin oder Notfallversorgung und Erfahrung in einem Universitätskrankenhaus
• Die Fähigkeit, in einem interdisziplinären Team zu arbeiten
• Ein Initiativ-, Organisations- und Kollegialitätssinn
• Registrierung im Register der medizinischen Berufe (Medreg) Ihre Ziele sind:
• Gewährleistung der klinischen Aufsicht über die akute medizinische Behandlung (Bettenaufteilung, Notfälle, Intensivpflege)
• Teilnahme an Bereitschaftsdiensten
• Überwachung und Teilnahme an der Ausbildung von medizinischen Assistenten und medizinischen Studenten Wir sind:
• Eine Institution mit Akut- und Rehabilitationseinrichtungen, einer Privatklinik, EMS, medizinischen Zentren und Praxen, die in der Region La Côte und der ersten klinischen Hypnose-Schule, die dem medizinischen Umfeld in der französischsprachigen Schweiz gewidmet ist, verteilt sind.
• Ein Netzwerk von medizinischen Dienstleistungen, das viele Möglichkeiten für internes Transferieren entsprechend den Aspirationen und Entwicklungsprojekten der Mitarbeiter bietet.
• Mehr als 2000 Mitarbeiter, die sich um die Patienten und Bewohner der Region kümmern, indem sie Werte wie Verantwortung, Nähe, Humanität, Kompetenz teilen, in einer agilen Umgebung, die die Verwirklichung von Projekten fördert.
• Ein ausbildungsorientiertes Unternehmen, das sich der Ausbildung der nächsten Generation verschrieben hat, mit etwa 80 Lehrlingen in 16 verschiedenen Berufen, 200 HES-ES-Praktikanten und fast 300 ausbildenden Ärzten. Zusammen, Seite an Seite, seien Sie das nächste Talent unseres medizinischen Netzwerks. Erkennen Sie sich in dieser Beschreibung wieder? Klicken Sie auf 'Bewerben' und fügen Sie die folgenden Dokumente hinzu: CV, Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitsbescheinigungen (erforderlich für die Gehaltsberechnung) und Diplome. Wenn Ihre Bewerbung ausgewählt wird, wird ein Strafregisterauszug angefordert.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Policlinique, urgences, soins ambulatoires, hospitalisations : de la naissance au grand âge, l’Hôpital de Morges offre un large éventail de prestations de soins. L’établissement compte 240 lits de soins aigus, une maternité, avec environ 1'500 naissances par année, et près 30'000 consultations d’urgence. En tout, ce sont plus de 40 disciplines médicales qui sont pratiquées dans ses murs depuis plus de 150 ans. Entouré de vignes, avec une vue incroyable sur les montagnes et le lac, l’Hôpital de Morges vous accueille dans un cadre chaleureux et dynamique.

Nous recherchons pour l'Hôpital de Morges des :

Médecins Chefs-fes de clinique (-adjoint-es) en Médecine interne (F/H) à 100%

Afin de compléter l'équipe médicale du département de médecine, de suite ou à convenir, pour une durée de 6 mois à 2 ans, à définir.
Taux de travail à convenir.

NOUS VOUS OFFRONS

• Une équipe de formateurs, professeurs et médecins hautement qualifiés, assurant un encadrement et un développement professionnel de qualité.

• La renommée de l’hôpital et de ses médecins, offrant un cadre de travail valorisant et reconnu.

• Jusqu’à 5 jours de congé par année pour des formations vous sont accordé et des frais de formation jusqu’à 1'000 CHF maximum sont remboursés pour 12 mois d’activité.

• Plus de 20 disciplines reconnues « centre de formation ».

• 5 semaines de vacances annuelles, 6 semaines dès l'âge de 50 ans, ainsi que 10 jours fériés récupérés.

• Plusieurs propositions apportant de la flexibilité (congés non-payés, temps partiels, etc.).

• Des activités sportives (Pilates, courses à pied, réductions auprès de divers centres tels que plusieurs fitness ou les Bains de Lavey), des événements destinés aux enfants de collaborateur-trice-s, une buvette d’entreprise pour partager des moments de convivialité lors des beaux jours.

• Une rémunération basée sur la valorisation de vos années d’expériences professionnelles précédentes.

VOUS POSSÉDEZ

• Un diplôme de médecin reconnu et un titre de spécialiste fédéral ou formellement reconnu par la MEBEKO, inscrit au MedReg en médecine interne générale ou en cours d’obtention

• Plusieurs années de pratique hospitalière en soins aigus de médecine interne ou aux urgences et une expérience en hôpital universitaire

• La capacité de travailler en équipe interdisciplinaire

• Un esprit d’initiative, d’organisation et de collégialité

• L’inscription au Registre des professions médicales est demandée (Medreg)

VOS OBJECTIFS

• Assurer la supervision clinique des soins aigus de médecine interne (division des lits, urgences, soins intensifs)

• Participer aux gardes

• Superviser et participer à la formation des médecins-assistants et des étudiants en médecine

NOUS SOMMES

• Une institution comprenant des établissements de soins aigus et réadaptation, une clinique privée, des EMS, des centres médicaux et des permanences répartis dans la région de La Côte ainsi que la 1ère école d'hypnose clinique dédiée au milieu du soins en Suisse romande.

• Un réseau de soins permettant de nombreuses opportunités de mutation interne selon les aspirations et projets de développement des collaborateurs.

• Plus de 2000 collaborateurs prenant soin des patients et résidents de la région, en partageant des valeurs de Responsabilité, Proximité, Humanité, Compétence, dans un environnement agile favorisant la réalisation des projets.

• Une entreprise formatrice engagée dans la formation de la relève, comptant environ 80 apprentis dans 16 métiers différents, 200 stagiaires HES-ES et près de 300 médecins en formation.

ENSEMBLE CÔTE À CÔTE, SOYEZ LE PROCHAIN TALENT DE NOTRE RESEAU DE SOIN.

Vous reconnaissez-vous dans cette description ?
Cliquez sur Postulez en ajoutant les documents suivants :
CV, lettre de motivation, certificats de travail (nécessaires pour l'élaboration du calcul de salaire) et diplômes (MEBEKO).
Si votre candidature est sélectionnée, l’extrait de votre casier judiciaire vous sera demandé.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Aubonne Hospital ha servito la sua comunità dal 1895. Idealmente situato vicino ai vigneti e al villaggio, è uno dei tre ospedali fondatori dell'EHC. Esso riunisce tutte le missioni dell'EHC in un unico luogo: medicina di primo rapporto con il suo centro medico, cura acuta con i suoi letti riconosciuti di medicina interna e la sua unità di assistenza palliativa, il centro di trattamento e riabilitazione multi-sito o cura a lungo termine con il suo SME e il suo Centro di accoglienza temporanea (CAT). Stiamo cercando un membro dell'Ospedale Aubonne per il novembre 2026: Testa di Palliative e RTC (F/H) Clinica a 70 - 100% Per rafforzare il nostro servizio. Noi ti
• Un team di formatori altamente qualificati, professori e medici, assicurando la supervisione e lo sviluppo professionale di qualità.
• La reputazione dell'ospedale e dei suoi medici, fornendo un ambiente di lavoro prezioso e riconosciuto.
• 5 giorni all'anno di " congedo di formazione" e 1'000 CHF di costi di formazione rimborsati oltre 12 mesi di attività.
• Più di 20 discipline riconosciute "centro di formazione".
• 5 settimane di vacanza annuale, 6 settimane dall'età di 50 anni. Possibilità di riscattare una settimana aggiuntiva di vacanza, così come 10 vacanze offerte.

• Un piano di mobilità che include la partecipazione al vostro viaggio in bicicletta o a basket o al vostro abbonamento di trasporto pubblico, in vista dell'ambiente a seguito di un piano stradale di sostenibilità istituzionale.
• Attività sportive (Pilates, gare a piedi, sconti in vari centri come diversi centri fitness o Bains de Lavey), eventi per i bambini di collaboratori, una bevanda aziendale per condividere momenti di convivialità durante le belle giornate.
• Bevande calde offerte al mattino e pasti a CHF 8.50 nelle nostre mense.
• Remunerazione basata sulla valutazione dei vostri anni precedenti di esperienza professionale e bonus di anzianità all'interno dell'EHC.
• Trasferimento interno facilitato secondo il vostro desiderio di sviluppo. Tu lo sai
• Il titolo di specialista federale o finale, riconosciuto in medicina interna generale da MEBEKO.
• Speciale interesse per la riabilitazione geriatrica e la cura palliativa.
• La capacità di lavorare come team interdisciplinare.
• Uno spirito di iniziativa, organizzazione e collegialità.
• Un mezzo di locomozione e una patente di guida, idealmente. OBIETTIVI
• Controllo clinico della gestione complessiva dei pazienti in riabilitazione geriatrica o assistenza palliativa.
• Lavorare in interdisciplinarità con i servizi di caregiver e terapeuti (ergo-physio, psy-neuropsy, infermieri, dietitians.ennes) allo scopo di cure coordinate e il raggiungimento di obiettivi comuni.
• Contattare e avere accesso privilegiato con cura acuta e specialisti della rete EHC, garantendo qualità medica e fluidità delle informazioni.
• Partecipa alle seconde guardie di linea, settimana e fine settimana, cioè una settimana su 5.
• Per supervisionare, sostenere e formare i 7 assistenti medici nello sviluppo delle loro competenze e nell'evoluzione del loro viaggio.
• Siate accompagnati da 3 medici specializzati in medicina interna, geriatria e assistenza palliativa in modo da contribuire al vostro sviluppo professionale. Siamo
• Un'istituzione costituita da strutture di cura e riabilitazione acuta, una clinica privata, SME, centri medici e permanenze nella regione di La Côte e la prima scuola di ipnosi clinica dedicata alla comunità di cura in Svizzera francofona.
• Una rete di cura che permette molte opportunità di trasformazione interna secondo le aspirazioni e i progetti di sviluppo dei collaboratori.
• Più di 2000 dipendenti che si occupano di pazienti e residenti della regione, condividono valori di Responsabilità, Proximità, Umanità, Competenza, in un ambiente agile favorevole alla realizzazione di progetti.
• Una società di formazione impegnata in formazione di successione, con circa 80 apprendisti in 16 diversi scambi, 200 HES-ES tirocinanti e quasi 300 medici in formazione. Essere il prossimo evento della nostra rete. Ti riconosci in questa descrizione? Fare clic su Applica aggiungendo i seguenti documenti: CV, lettera di copertura, certificati di lavoro (necessario per il calcolo dei salari) e diplomi (MEBEKO). Se la tua domanda è selezionata, ti verrà chiesto l'estratto dal tuo record penale.

Aubonne Hospital has served its community since 1895. Ideally located near the vineyards and the village, it is one of the three founding hospitals of the EHC. It brings together all the EHC's missions in one place: first-recourse medicine with its medical centre, acute care with its recognized beds of internal medicine and its palliative care unit, the multi-site treatment and rehabilitation centre or long-term care with its EMS and its Temporary Reception Centre (CAT). We are looking for a member of the Aubonne Hospital for November 2026: Head of Palliative and RTC (F/H) Clinic at 70 - 100% To strengthen our service. WE OFFER YOU
• A team of highly qualified trainers, professors and doctors, ensuring quality professional supervision and development.
• The reputation of the hospital and its doctors, providing a valuable and recognized work environment.
• 5 days per year of "training leave" and 1'000 CHF of training costs reimbursed over 12 months of activity.
• More than 20 recognized "training centre" disciplines.
• 5 weeks of annual vacation, 6 weeks from the age of 50. Possibility of redeeming an additional week of vacation, as well as 10 holidays offered.
• Several proposals providing flexibility (unpaid leave, part-time leave, paid exchange time, etc.).
• A mobility plan including participation in your cycling or basketball trip or your public transport subscription, with a view to the environment following an institutional sustainability road plan.

• Remuneration based on the valuation of your previous years of professional experience as well as seniority bonuses within the EHC.
• Internal transfer facilitated according to your desire for development. YOU MAY
• The title of federal or final specialist, recognized in general internal medicine by MEBEKO.
• Special interest in geriatric rehabilitation and palliative care.
• The ability to work as an interdisciplinary team.
• A spirit of initiative, organization and collegiality.
• A means of locomotion and a driving license, ideally. OBJECTIVES
• Clinical supervision of the overall management of patients in geriatric rehabilitation or palliative care.
• Work in interdisciplinarity with the services of caregivers and therapists (ergo-physio, psy-neuropsy, nurses, dietitians.ennes) for the purpose of coordinated care and the achievement of common objectives.
• Contact and have privileged access with acute care and specialists of the EHC network, guaranteeing medical quality and fluidity of information.
• Attend second line guards on call, week and weekends, i.e. one week out of 5.
• To supervise, support and train the 7 medical assistants in the development of their skills and the evolution of their journey.
• Be accompanied by 3 medical professionals specializing in internal medicine, geriatrics and palliative care so as to contribute to your professional development. WE ARE
• An institution consisting of acute care and rehabilitation facilities, a private clinic, EMS, medical centres and permanences in the region of La Côte and the first clinical hypnosis school dedicated to the care community in French-speaking Switzerland.
• A network of care allowing many opportunities for internal transformation according to the aspirations and development projects of the collaborators.
• More than 2000 employees taking care of patients and residents of the region, sharing values of Responsibility, Proximity, Humanity, Competence, in an agile environment conducive to the realization of projects.

Infermiera dottoressa (M/F) all'80-100%

Inizio lavori al più presto o da concordare.

Il dipartimento di medicina al 1° piano dispone di 40 posti letto, di cui 6 dedicati alle cure palliative, e fornisce assistenza interdisciplinare ai pazienti che necessitano di cure palliative generali e acute.

Il reparto di medicina al 2° piano comprende 43 posti letto, metà dei quali dedicati all'assistenza acuta degli anziani, con cure interdisciplinari in un ambiente idoneo volte a promuovere e mantenere l'autonomia nelle attività della vita quotidiana.

NOI TI OFFRIAMO

• Lezioni gratuite di pilates, partecipazione economica ad eventi sportivi come la 20km di Losanna o Bike to Work, un catalogo di vantaggi con sconti nei settori dello sport, del benessere, del tempo libero, della mobilità, delle assicurazioni e della finanza.

• Un punto di ristoro aziendale “Pâquis Plage” per condividere momenti conviviali nelle giornate di sole.

• Possibilità di trasferimenti interni, secondo i vostri desideri di sviluppo.

• Numerosi corsi di formazione interni o di certificazione disponibili.

• Un programma dedicato ai dirigenti per supportarli nell'acquisizione delle competenze necessarie per gestire i propri team.

PROPRIETI

• Una laurea HES in infermieristica o un diploma infermieristico riconosciuto dalla Croce Rossa Svizzera.

• Grande adattamento alle esigenze dei diversi servizi ai quali sei delegato.

• Buone capacità organizzative (anticipare, pianificare, coordinare) e rigore.

• La capacità di prendere iniziativa e responsabilità.

• Buon controllo emotivo, proattività e flessibilità.

• Flessibilità e disponibilità a lavorare giorno e notte, nonché nei giorni feriali e 2 fine settimana al mese.

• Sviluppare obiettivi assistenziali con il paziente, i suoi cari e l'équipe multidisciplinare, sulla base dei dati raccolti e tenendo conto di un progetto terapeutico complessivo.

In all, more than 40 medical disciplines have been practiced within its walls for more than 150 years. Surrounded by vineyards, with an incredible view of the mountains and the lake, the Morges Hospital welcomes you in a warm and dynamic setting.

Nurse in doctor (M/F) at 80-100%

Start of work as soon as possible or to be agreed.

The medicine department on the 2nd floor includes 43 beds, half of which are dedicated to acute care for seniors, with interdisciplinary care in a suitable environment aimed at promoting and maintaining autonomy in daily life activities.

WE OFFER YOU

• 5 weeks of annual vacation, 6 weeks from the age of 50. Possibility of buying back an additional week of vacation, as well as 10 free public holidays.

• Several proposals providing flexibility (unpaid leave, part-time work, paid exchange time, etc.).

• A mobility plan including participation in your bike ride, basketball ride or your public transport subscription, with concern for the environment following a sustainability plan at institutional level.

• Remuneration based on the value of your years of previous professional experience, as well as bonuses linked to seniority within the EHC.

• Free pilates classes, financial participation in sporting events such as the Lausanne 20km or Bike to Work, a catalog of benefits offering discounts in the areas of sport, well-being, leisure, mobility, insurance and finance.

• Free hot drinks in the morning and meals for CHF 8.50 in our cafeterias.

• A “Pâquis Plage” company refreshment bar to share convivial moments on sunny days.

• Possibilities for internal transfers, according to your development desires.

• Numerous internal or certification training courses available.

• A program dedicated to executives to support them in acquiring the skills necessary to manage their teams.

YOU OWN

• An HES Bachelor's degree in nursing or nursing diploma recognized by the Swiss Red Cross.

• Great adaptation to the requirements of the different services in which you are delegated.

• Good organizational skills (anticipate, plan, coordinate) and rigor.

• The ability to take initiative and responsibility.

• Good emotional control, proactivity and flexibility.

• Flexibility and availability to work day and night as well as weekdays and 2 weekends per month.

YOUR OBJECTIVES

• Ensure the care of the patients entrusted to him while respecting institutional values.

• Develop care objectives with the patient, their loved ones and the multidisciplinary team, based on the data collected and taking into account an overall therapeutic project.

• Work interprofessionally with the aim of providing quality care and respecting a global approach to the patient.

WE ARE

• An institution comprising acute care and rehabilitation establishments, a private clinic, EMS, medical centers and hotlines spread across the La Côte region as well as the 1st clinical hypnosis school dedicated to the healthcare sector in French-speaking Switzerland.

• A healthcare network allowing numerous opportunities for internal transfer according to the aspirations and development projects of employees.

• More than 2,000 employees caring for patients and residents of the region, sharing values ​​of Responsibility, Proximity, Humanity, Competence, in an agile environment favoring the completion of projects.

• A training company committed to training the next generation, with around 80 apprentices in 16 different professions, 200 HES-ES trainees and nearly 300 doctors in training.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Policlinic, emergency, outpatient care, hospitalizations: from birth to old age, the Morges Hospital offers a wide range of care services. The establishment has 240 acute care beds, one maternity, with about 1,500 births per year, and nearly 30,000 emergency consultations. In all, more than 40 medical disciplines have been practiced in its walls for more than 150 years. Surrounded by vineyards, with incredible views of the mountains and the lake, the Morges Hospital welcomes you in a warm and dynamic setting.

We are looking for for our services of Pôle Plaie and Stomatherapy of the hospital of Morges one(e):

Nurse (H/F) at the Plaice Pole and 80% Stomatherapy

WE OFFER YOU

• An interdisciplinary and individualised management that promotes proximity to the patient as well as to a dynamic, available and welded medical team

• Week schedules, Monday to Friday, from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.

• 5 weeks of annual vacation, 6 weeks from the age of 50. Possibility to buy another week of vacation, as well as 10 holidays offered.

• Several proposals providing flexibility (unpaid leave, part-time leave, paid exchange time, etc.).

• A mobility plan including participation in your cycling, basketball or public transport subscription, with an environmental focus on an institutional sustainability plan.

• Remuneration based on the valuation of your previous years of professional experience, as well as seniority bonuses within the EHC.

• Free pilates courses, financial participation at sporting events such as the 20km of Lausanne or Bike to Work, a catalogue of advantages offering discounts in the fields of sport, well-being, leisure, mobility, insurance and finance.

• Hot drinks offered in the morning and meals at CHF 8.50 in our cafeterias.

• A "Pâquis Plage" business drink to share moments of conviviality during the beautiful days.

• Opportunities for internal change, according to your desire for development.

• Many accessible in-house or certifying training courses.

• A programme dedicated to managers to support them in acquiring the skills necessary to manage their teams.

YOU MAY

• A B.H.S. in nursing or a recognized CRS nursing degree

• Post-graduate training (CAS or DU) in Plaice and Cicatrization, or a minimum of 2 years experience in the field of acute and chronic wounds with the desire to form.

• A training course for a stomatherapist or the willingness to be trained in this field.

• An expert posture and clinical autonomy

• A great autonomy while knowing how to work in interdisciplinarity

• Ability to communicate positively and constructively

OBJECTIVES

• Develop care objectives with the patient, his or her relatives, the interdisciplinary team, based on the data collected and taking into account a comprehensive therapeutic project.

• Provide wound care and healing expertise to service nurses, physicians and other stakeholders

• Provide quality care in terms of technical and relational care, therapeutic education, counselling and support for stomatal patients with external fistula and/or continence disorders

• Cross-sectional intervention throughout the institution, in outpatients and at home, in interprofessional coordination

• Contribute to the harmonization of care practices in these specific areas and participate in the development of projects carried out

• Work in partnership with the Stomatherapy/Wound Pole team and the medical-care teams at our five hospital sites, internally and externally, at home, in collaboration with the Fondation de La Côte.

WE ARE

• An institution consisting of acute care and rehabilitation facilities, a private clinic, EMS, medical centres and permanences in the region of La Côte and the first clinical hypnosis school dedicated to the care community in French-speaking Switzerland.

• A network of care allowing many opportunities for internal transformation according to the aspirations and development projects of the collaborators.

• More than 2,000 employees taking care of patients and residents of the region, sharing values of Responsibility, Proximity, Humanity, Competence, in an agile environment conducive to the realization of projects.

• A training company engaged in succession training, with about 80 apprentices in 16 different trades, 200 HES-ES trainees and nearly 300 doctors in training.

BE THE NEXT TALENT OF OUR CARE NETWORK.

CV, cover letter, work certificates (necessary for the calculation of wages) and diplomas.

Insgesamt werden seit mehr als 150 Jahren mehr als 40 medizinische Disziplinen in seinen Mauern praktiziert. Umgeben von Weinbergen mit unglaublichem Blick auf die Berge und den See begrüßt Sie das Morges Hospital in einer warmen und dynamischen Umgebung.

Krankenschwester (H / F) am Scholle Pole und 80% Stomatherapie

• Viele zugängliche interne oder zertifizierende Schulungen.

Dürfen

• Eine große Autonomie, während man weiß, wie man in Interdisziplinarität arbeitet

ZIELE

• Bereitstellung einer qualitativ hochwertigen Versorgung in Bezug auf technische und relationale Versorgung, therapeutische Ausbildung, Beratung und Unterstützung für stomatale Patienten mit externen Fisteln und / oder Kontinenzstörungen

• Querschnittsintervention in der gesamten Einrichtung, ambulant und zu Hause, in interprofessioneller Koordination

• Beitrag zur Harmonisierung der Pflegepraktiken in diesen spezifischen Bereichen und Beteiligung an der Entwicklung der durchgeführten Projekte

• Arbeiten Sie in Partnerschaft mit dem Team Stomatherapy/Wound Pole und den medizinischen Pflegeteams an unseren fünf Krankenhausstandorten, intern und extern, zu Hause, in Zusammenarbeit mit der Fondation de La Côte.

WIR SIND

• Mehr als 2.000 Mitarbeiter kümmern sich um Patienten und Bewohner der Region und teilen Werte wie Verantwortung, Nähe, Menschlichkeit, Kompetenz in einem agilen Umfeld, das der Realisierung von Projekten förderlich ist.

• Eine Ausbildungsfirma, die sich mit Nachfolgeausbildung beschäftigt, mit etwa 80 Auszubildenden in 16 verschiedenen Berufen, 200 HES-ES-Auszubildenden und fast 300 Ärzten in der Ausbildung.

Sei das nächste Talent unseres Pflegenetzes.

Erkennst du dich selbst in dieser Beschreibung?

Lebenslauf, Anschreiben, Arbeitsbescheinigungen (für die Berechnung der Löhne erforderlich) und Diplome.

With 42 rehabilitation beds, this ideally located establishment offers stunning views of the Alps and Geneva. In addition, our five-seat temporary reception centre (CAT) offers activities for seniors four days a week.

We're looking for Gilly Hospital one:

Nurse (M/F) in CTR at 80-100%

Posting as soon as possible or as appropriate.

WE OFFER YOU

• Free parking spaces with your vehicle or support for travel between Rolle station and Gilly site by EHC.

• 5 weeks of annual vacation, 6 weeks from the age of 50. Possibility of redeeming an additional week of vacation, as well as 10 holidays offered.

• Several proposals providing flexibility (unpaid leave, part-time leave, paid exchange time, etc.).

• A mobility plan including participation in your cycling, basketball or public transport subscription, with an environmental focus on an institutional sustainability plan.

• Remuneration based on the valuation of your previous years of professional experience, as well as seniority bonuses within the EHC.

• Free pilates courses, financial participation in sporting events such as the 20km of Lausanne or Bike to Work, a catalogue of advantages offering discounts in the fields of sport, well-being, leisure, mobility, insurance and finance.

• Hot drinks offered in the morning and meals at CHF 8.50 in our cafeterias.

• A "Pâquis Plage" business drink to share moments of conviviality during the beautiful days.

• Opportunities for internal change, according to your desire for development.

• Many accessible in-house or certifying training.

• A programme dedicated to managers to support them in acquiring the skills necessary to manage their teams.

YOU MAY

• A Bachelor of Nursing (HES) in Nursing or a Grade 2 nursing degree, recognized as CRS.

• An initial experience in a medical, geriatric or rehabilitation service, an asset.

• Good organisational skills (prevent, plan, coordinate), flexibility and proactivity.

• A capacity to perform continuous hours in 12h00 alternating days and nights.

• Ability to take initiatives and responsibilities.

• A sense of listening and a relational ease.

YOUR OBJECTIVES

• Care for the patient entrusted to her in accordance with institutional values.

• Identify the patient's needs and resources systematically.

• Develop care objectives with the patient, his or her relatives, the multidisciplinary team, based on the data collected and taking into account a comprehensive therapeutic project.

• Work in interprofessionality with the aim of providing quality care and respecting a comprehensive patient approach.

• Collaborate with all relevant stakeholders on continuous improvement of practices and good organization of the service.

WE ARE

• An institution consisting of acute care and rehabilitation institutions, a private clinic, EMS, medical centres and permanences located in the region of La Côte and the first clinical hypnosis school dedicated to the care community in French-speaking Switzerland.

• A network of care allowing many opportunities for internal change according to the aspirations and development projects of employees.

• More than 2,000 employees taking care of patients and residents of the region, sharing values of Responsibility, Proximity, Humanity, Competence, in an agile environment conducive to the realization of projects.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
La Permanence Pédiatrique Nord-Sud est un centre médical qui a ouvert ses portes le 8 janvier 2025 pour accueillir les enfants de 0 à 16 ans sans rendez-vous pour des urgences chirurgicales et médicales 7 j/7. L’équipe médicale est formée de pédiatres expérimentés, permettant des prises en charges de qualité et rapides. Les locaux modernes et équipés donnent la possibilité de faire des radiographies et du laboratoire, ainsi que des traitements de plaies ou de fractures simples. L’équipe est complétée par une équipe infirmière habituée aux prises en charge pédiatriques. Les suivis orthopédiques peuvent se faire avec un spécialiste sur site ou au centre GO2, spécialisé dans la prise en charge orthopédique des adolescents.

Nous recherchons pour la policlinique Nord-Sud un(e) :

Chef de clinique en pédiatrie (F/H) à 60-100%

Taux à convenir entre 60% et 100%
Entrée en fonction : octobre ou novembre 2026

NOUS VOUS OFFRONS

• Une équipe de formateurs, professeurs et médecins hautement qualifiés, assurant un encadrement et un développement professionnel de qualité.

• La renommée de l’hôpital et de ses médecins, offrant un cadre de travail valorisant et reconnu.

• 5 jours par année de « congé formation » ainsi que 1'000 CHF de frais de formation remboursés sur 12 mois d’activité.

• Plus de 20 disciplines reconnues « centre de formation ».

• 5 semaines de vacances annuelles, 6 semaines dès l'âge de 50 ans. Possibilité de rachat d’une semaine de vacances supplémentaire, ainsi que 10 jours fériés offerts.

• Plusieurs propositions apportant de la flexibilité (congés non-payés, temps partiels, temps de change rémunéré, etc.).

• Des activités sportives (Pilates, courses à pied, réductions auprès de divers centres tels que plusieurs fitness ou les Bains de Lavey), des événements destinés aux enfants de collaborateur-trice-s, une buvette d’entreprise pour partager des moments de convivialité lors des beaux jours.

• Une rémunération basée sur la valorisation de vos années d’expériences professionnelles précédentes ainsi que des primes liées à l’ancienneté au sein de l’EHC.

• Mutation à l’interne facilitée selon vos envies de développement.

VOUS POSSÉDEZ

• Un diplôme de médecin Suisse ou reconnu et un titre de spécialiste fédéral ou enregistré et entièrement reconnu par le MedReg en pédiatrie .

• Une solide expérience en pédiatrie

• La capacité à travailler de manière autonome

• De la souplesse, un esprit d’équipe, du dynamisme et le sens des responsabilités.

VOS OBJECTIFS

• Assurer une prise en charge clinique des patients ambulatoires.

• Collaborer avec les équipes pluridisciplinaires.

NOUS SOMMES

• Une institution comprenant des établissements de soins aigus et réadaptation, une clinique privée, des EMS, des centres médicaux et des permanences répartis dans la région de La Côte ainsi que la 1ère école d'hypnose clinique dédiée au milieu du soins en Suisse romande.

• Un réseau de soins permettant de nombreuses opportunités de mutation interne selon les aspirations et projets de développement des collaborateurs.

• Plus de 2000 collaborateurs prenant soin des patients et résidents de la région, en partageant des valeurs de Responsabilité, Proximité, Humanité, Compétence, dans un environnement agile favorisant la réalisation des projets.

• Une entreprise formatrice engagée dans la formation de la relève, comptant environ 80 apprentis dans 16 métiers différents, 200 stagiaires HES-ES et près de 300 médecins en formation.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'Ensemble Hospitalier de la Côte - EHC è un network di salute a servizio da oltre 20 anni. Raccoglie strutture con missioni complementari di cure acute, riabilitazione, ospitalità in EMS e medicina di primo soccorso. Noi forniamo più di 40 discipline mediche al fine di prendersi cura di ogni paziente e residente, grazie a più di 2'000 professionisti che lavorano quotidianamente per offrire cure di qualità. Noi cerchiamo per i nostri Etablissements medico-sociali (EMS) di Morges e di Aubonne: 4 Apprendisti ASA - Assistenti sanitarie e accompagnamento (F/H) Dal 1° agosto 2026. NOI TI OFFRIAMO:
• L'opportunità di contribuire all'accompagnamento e alle cure dei anziani in EMS, grazie a un tournus di formazione che ti permetterà di scoprire 2 missioni (geriatria e psichiatria di età avanzata).
• L'occasione di imparare, partecipare e realizzare un accompagnamento in una visione interprofessionale basata su valori umanisti.
• L'opportunità di beneficiare di un follow-up di vicinanza durante il tuo apprendimento, da parte di formatori coinvolti e esperti, che ti accompagneranno verso la riuscita del tuo AFP d'ASA.
• La possibilità di scoprire il mondo del lavoro all'interno di un'istituzione in piena evoluzione e la cui missione è quella di prendersi cura di tutto il nostro paziente-e e resident-e.
• L'opportunità di integrare un apprendimento che comprende un tournus di formazione per diversi mestieri.
• 6 settimane di vacanze annuali, così come 10 giorni di ferie offerti.
• Un piano di mobilità che comprende una partecipazione al tuo tragitto a bicicletta, in basket o in trasporti pubblici.
• Corsi di pilates gratuiti, una partecipazione finanziaria a eventi sportivi come i 20km di Losanna o Bike to Work, un catalogo di vantaggi che propone sconti nei settori dello sport, del benessere, dei divertimenti, della mobilità, delle assicurazioni e delle finanze.
• Le bevande calde offerte la mattina e i pasti a CHF 8.50 nelle nostre cantine.
• Una baracca aziendale « Pâquis Plage » per condividere momenti di convivialità durante i bei giorni.
• La possibilità di beneficiare di un tempo definito sulla postazione di lavoro per la preparazione dei tuoi esami finali.
• Un accesso privilegiato ai posti fissi o aperti sull'intera nostra rete, a partire dalla fine del tuo apprendimento. TU POSSIEDI:
• Un certificato di fine scolarità obbligatoria o arrivi presto al termine della tua scolarità.
• Un progetto professionale ben definito, grazie a un stage di osservazione in EMS che ti ha permesso di confermare la tua scelta.
• Una vera motivazione a impegnarti per 2 anni nell'accompagnamento di persone anziane e fragili nella loro salute.
• Una natura dinamica, volontaria e empatica, che dimostri maturità e facilità nel lavoro di squadra.
• Una buona capacità di adattamento che ti permette di seguire un tournus di formazione che prevede il passaggio per 2 servizi formatori durante il tuo apprendimento.
• Un buon livello di italiano e il senso dell'ascolto. TESI OBIETTIVI:
• Partecipare all'accompagnamento dei residenti nella vita quotidiana e incoraggiarli a partecipare alla vita sociale.
• Partecipare alle cure di salute e alle cure corporee.
• Offrire la tua assistenza nelle attività di intendanza.
• Collaborare con i professionisti dell'équipe interprofessionale, al fine di assicurare una presa in cura di qualità dei residenti. NOI SIAMO:
• Un'istituzione che comprende strutture di cure acute e riabilitazione, una clinica privata, EMS, centri medici e presenze diurne distribuite nella regione di La Côte, così come la prima scuola di ipnosi clinica dedicata al mondo dei servizi in Svizzera romanda.
• Un network di cure che permette molte opportunità di mutamento interno secondo le aspirazioni e i progetti di sviluppo dei collaboratori.
• Più di 2000 collaboratori che si prendono cura dei pazienti e dei residenti della regione, condividendo valori di Responsabilità, Prossimità, Umanità, Competenza, in un ambiente agile che favorisce la realizzazione dei progetti.
• Un'azienda formatrice impegnata nella formazione della prossima generazione, che conta circa 80 apprendisti in 16 mestieri diversi, 200 stagisti HES-ES e circa 300 medici in formazione. ENSEMBLE CÔTE A CÔTE, DIVENTI IL PROSSIMO TALENTO DEL NOSTRO RETE DI CURA. Ti riconosci in questa descrizione? Allora candidati direttamente online aggiungendo i seguenti documenti: il tuo CV, la tua lettera di motivazione che spiega il tuo interesse per questo mestiere, l'insieme delle tue valutazioni di stage, così come l'insieme dei tuoi bullettini scolastici e diplomi ottenuti. Solo i dossier completi saranno presi in considerazione. Se la tua candidatura è selezionata, l'estrazione del tuo casellario giudiziario ti sarà richiesta.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Ensemble Hospitalier de la Côte - EHC is a health network in service for over 20 years. It brings together facilities with complementary missions of acute care, rehabilitation, EMS, and primary care. We deliver over 40 medical disciplines in order to take care of each patient and resident, thanks to over 2,000 professionals working daily to offer quality care. We are looking for 4 Apprentice ASA - Care and Support Assistants (F/H) for our Medical-Social Establishments (EMS) in Morges and Aubonne: From August 1, 2026. WE OFFER YOU:
• The opportunity to contribute to the care and support of the elderly in EMS, thanks to a training schedule that will allow you to discover 2 missions (geriatrics and advanced psychiatric care).
• The opportunity to learn, participate, and achieve a support role in an interprofessional vision based on humanist values.
• The opportunity to benefit from a close follow-up during your training, by experienced and involved trainers, who will accompany you to the success of your ASA AFP.
• The opportunity to discover the world of work within an institution in full evolution and whose mission is to take care of all our patients and residents.
• The opportunity to integrate an apprenticeship that includes a training schedule for different professions.
• 6 weeks of annual leave, as well as 10 paid holidays.
• A mobility plan that includes a contribution to your bike, basket, or public transport journey.
• Free Pilates courses, a financial contribution to sports events such as the 20km of Lausanne or Bike to Work, a catalog of benefits offering discounts in the fields of sports, well-being, leisure, mobility, insurance, and finance.
• Hot drinks offered in the morning and meals at CHF 8.50 in our canteens.
• A company bar « Pâquis Plage » to share convivial moments during the beautiful days.
• The opportunity to benefit from a defined time on the workstation for the preparation of your final exams.
• Priority access to fixed posts or open on our entire network, from the end of your apprenticeship. YOU POSSESS:
• A compulsory end-of-school certificate or you are about to reach the end of your schooling.
• A well-defined professional project, thanks to an observation internship in EMS that allowed you to confirm your choice.
• A genuine motivation to commit for 2 years to the care of elderly and fragile people in their health.
• A dynamic, voluntary, and empathetic nature, demonstrating maturity and ease in teamwork.
• A good capacity for adaptation that allows you to follow a training schedule that includes the passage through 2 training services during your apprenticeship.
• A good level of French and the sense of listening. YOUR OBJECTIVES:
• Participate in the care of residents in daily life and encourage them to participate in social life.
• Participate in health care and body care.
• Provide assistance in household chores.
• Collaborate with the professionals of the interprofessional team, in order to ensure quality care of the residents. WE ARE:
• An institution that includes acute care and rehabilitation facilities, a private clinic, EMS, medical centers, and daytime presence distributed in the La Côte region, as well as the first clinical hypnosis school dedicated to the world of care in the Romandie.
• A care network that allows many opportunities for internal mobility according to the aspirations and development projects of the collaborators.
• Over 2,000 collaborators taking care of patients and residents in the region, sharing values of Responsibility, Proximity, Humanity, Competence, in an agile environment that favors the realization of projects.
• A training company committed to training the next generation, with around 80 apprentices in 16 different professions, 200 HES-ES interns, and around 300 doctors in training. ENSEMBLE CÔTE A CÔTE, BECOME THE NEXT TALENT OF OUR CARE NETWORK. Do you recognize yourself in this description? Then apply directly online by adding the following documents: your CV, your motivation letter explaining your interest in this profession, all your internship evaluations, as well as all your school reports and diplomas obtained. Only complete dossiers will be taken into account. If your application is selected, your judicial record will be requested.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Das Ensemble Hospitalier de la Côte - EHC ist ein Gesundheitsnetzwerk, das seit über 20 Jahren in Dienst steht. Es bringt zusammen Einrichtungen mit ergänzenden Missionen von akuter Pflege, Rehabilitation, EMS und Primärversorgung. Wir liefern über 40 medizinische Disziplinen, um jeden Patienten und Bewohner zu pflegen, dank über 2.000 Fachkräften, die täglich qualitativ hochwertige Pflege anbieten. Wir suchen für unsere medizinisch-sozialen Einrichtungen (EMS) in Morges und Aubonne: 4 Praktikanten ASA - Pflege- und Unterstützungshelfer (F/H) Ab dem 1. August 2026. WIR Bieten Ihnen:
• Die Gelegenheit, sich an der Pflege und Unterstützung der Älteren in EMS zu beteiligen, dank eines Ausbildungsplans, der es Ihnen ermöglicht, 2 Missionen (Gerontologie und fortgeschrittene psychiatrische Versorgung) zu entdecken.
• Die Gelegenheit, zu lernen, teilzunehmen und eine Unterstützungsrolle in einer interprofessionellen Vision zu erreichen, die auf humanistischen Werten basiert.
• Die Gelegenheit, von einem engen Follow-up während Ihres Trainings zu profitieren, von erfahrenen und involvierten Ausbildern, die Sie zu dem Erfolg Ihres ASA-AFP begleiten.
• Die Gelegenheit, das Welt der Arbeit innerhalb einer Institution in vollem Umbruch zu entdecken und deren Mission ist es, sich um alle unsere Patienten und Bewohner zu kümmern.
• Die Gelegenheit, ein Ausbildungsprogramm zu integrieren, das einen Ausbildungsplan für verschiedene Berufe umfasst.
• 6 Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr, sowie 10 bezahlte Feiertage.
• Ein Mobilitätsplan, der eine Beitragszahlung zu Ihrem Fahrrad, Basket oder öffentlichen Verkehr beinhaltet.
• Kostenlose Pilates-Kurse, eine finanzielle Beitragszahlung zu Sportveranstaltungen wie den 20km von Lausanne oder Bike to Work, ein Katalog von Vorteilen, der Rabatte in den Bereichen Sport, Wohlbefinden, Freizeit, Mobilität, Versicherungen und Finanzen bietet.
• Heißgetränke, die am Morgen angeboten werden, und Mahlzeiten zu CHF 8,50 in unseren Cafeterien.
• Eine Betriebsbar « Pâquis Plage » zum Teilen von convivialen Momenten während der schönen Tage.
• Die Gelegenheit, von einem definierten Zeitraum auf der Arbeitsstation für die Vorbereitung Ihrer Abschlussprüfungen zu profitieren.
• Prioritäres Zugang zu festen Arbeitsplätzen oder offenen auf unserem gesamten Netzwerk, ab dem Ende Ihres Ausbildungsprogramms. SIE POSSESSIEREN:
• Ein obligatorisches Abschlusszeugnis oder Sie sind bald am Ende Ihrer Ausbildung.
• Ein gut definiertes Berufsprojekt, dank eines Praktikums in EMS, das Ihnen ermöglichte, Ihre Wahl zu bestätigen.
• Eine echte Motivation, sich für 2 Jahre der Pflege von älteren und fragilen Personen in ihrer Gesundheit zu widmen.
• Eine dynamische, freiwillige und empathische Natur, die Reife und Leichtigkeit in der Teamarbeit zeigt.
• Eine gute Anpassungsfähigkeit, die es Ihnen ermöglicht, einen Ausbildungsplan zu folgen, der den Übergang durch 2 Ausbildungsstellen während Ihres Ausbildungsprogramms beinhaltet.
• Ein gutes Französisch und das Gefühl der Zuhörigkeit. IHR ZIELE:
• Beteiligung an der Pflege der Bewohner im Alltag und Ermutigung, sich an der sozialen Teilhabe zu beteiligen.
• Beteiligung an der Gesundheitspflege und Körperpflege.
• Unterstützung bei Haushaltsarbeiten.
• Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachkräften der interprofessionellen Team, um eine qualitativ hochwertige Pflege der Bewohner sicherzustellen. WIR SIND:
• Eine Institution, die Einrichtungen für akute Pflege und Rehabilitation, eine private Klinik, EMS, medizinische Zentren und Tagespräsenzen in der Region La Côte umfasst, sowie die erste klinische Hypnose-Schule, die sich dem Bereich der Pflege in der Romandie widmet.
• Ein Pflegenetwerk, das viele Möglichkeiten für interne Mobilität nach den Aspirationen und Entwicklungsvorhaben der Mitarbeiter bietet.
• Über 2.000 Mitarbeiter, die sich um die Patienten und Bewohner in der Region kümmern, Werte von Verantwortung, Nähe, Humanität, Kompetenz, in einem agilen Umfeld, das die Realisierung von Projekten fördert.
• Eine Ausbildungseinrichtung, die sich der Ausbildung der nächsten Generation widmet, mit etwa 80 Praktikanten in 16 verschiedenen Berufen, 200 HES-ES-Praktikanten und etwa 300 Ärzten in Ausbildung. ENSEMBLE CÔTE A CÔTE, WERDEN SIE ZUM NÄCHSTEN TALENT DES PFLEGENETZWERKS. Erkennen Sie sich in dieser Beschreibung? Dann bewerben Sie sich direkt online, indem Sie die folgenden Dokumente hinzufügen: Ihr CV, Ihre Motivationsbrief, der Ihre Interessen an diesem Beruf erklärt, alle Ihre Praktikumsbewertungen, sowie alle Ihre Schulzeugnisse und Diplome. Nur vollständige Dossiers werden berücksichtigt. Wenn Ihre Bewerbung ausgewählt wird, wird Ihr Strafregister angefordert.

• What we offer - A training plan that involves discovering 2 missions (geriatrics and advanced age psychiatry) within at least 2 different sites, between Morges and Aubonne. - The opportunity to discover the world of work within an institution in full evolution and whose mission is to take care of all our patients and residents. - The opportunity to benefit from a close follow-up during your apprenticeship, by experienced and involved trainers who will accompany you to the success of your CFC. - The opportunity to integrate an apprenticeship that includes a rotation of training for different trades. - 6 weeks of annual leave, as well as 10 paid holidays. - A mobility plan that includes a contribution to your bike, basketball or public transport journey. - Free Pilates courses, a financial contribution to sports events such as the 20km of Lausanne or Bike to Work, a catalog of benefits offering discounts in the fields of sports, well-being, leisure, mobility, insurance, and finance. - Free hot drinks in the morning and meals at CHF 8.50 in our cafeterias. - A company canteen « Pâquis Plage » to share convivial moments during the beautiful days. - The opportunity to benefit from a defined time on the workstation for the preparation of your final exams. - A privileged access to fixed posts open on the entire network of our sites, from the end of your apprenticeship.
